verdict.rationale: The axis applies because NVIDIA markets the RTX 5080 as a platform for private on-device AI. Its docs say users can run the latest AI models locally, "fully private on your RTX-powered PC," and add their own files. That implies user data stays on the device rather than feeding model training, but the docs never state this outright. missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is not used for AI training, a documented opt-out or data-use policy for NVIDIA software (NVIDIA app, G-Assist), and independent verification that local workflows send no data back.
